reviews.title: Fun Health app with some wonky issues
reviews.text:
1. the support email button is non-functional within the app, hence this very public and honest review. 

2. the app randomly messages me in Korean, even though my native language is English and I have the language set to English

3. I will have something like a chicken breast salad and a slice of grain bread and AI will say “next time, try adding a side of mixed greens for even more nutrition!” 

4. One of the AI personalities always says “low-key” and “not bad at all”. Not every meal is low-key impressive. Some meals are super impressive. 

5. The AI pushes a lot of avocado. Every other meal “try adding some avocado for healthy fats and extra satiety.” *I don’t want to spend money on avocado.* I can get healthy fats in other ways. 

Other than those issues( this app is amazing. I do have fun with the AI but it does feel like a doll you pull the string and it says some lines (like from the 1960’s). But I would hate for the feature to be discontinued.

reviews.title: Sanaé review
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Mealo Pocket AI Fitness Coach for a while now, and I’m genuinely impressed with how well it supports my fitness goals. The app feels like having a personal trainer and nutrition coach combined into one. The AI creates customized workout plans based on my schedule, energy level, and progress, and it actually adapts when I miss a day or need something lighter. That flexibility has kept me consistent in a way other fitness apps never did.

One of my favorite features is how smooth the meal tracking is. Instead of feeling like a chore, the app gives smart suggestions and reminders that help me stay on track without being overwhelming. The coaching messages feel encouraging and surprisingly personal, not robotic. I also appreciate how clean and intuitive the interface is — everything is easy to find, quick to update, and visually motivating.

I’ve seen real improvement in my routine, my energy, and even my overall discipline. Mealo Pocket really helped me stay accountable, and it feels like the app “learns” me over time. If you’re looking for a fitness coach that fits in your pocket and actually adapts to your lifestyle, this is definitely worth downloading. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: This app is Amazing
reviews.text: Mealo is an incredible calorie tracking app because it combines simplicity with powerful features. Its user-friendly interface makes tracking meals a breeze, whether you're at home or dining out. The app has an extensive database of foods, allowing quick logging with just a few taps. Mealo also offers personalized nutrition insights, helping users set goals and track progress over time. The barcode scanner feature is a game-changer, making it easy to log packaged foods. Additionally, Mealo integrates seamlessly with fitness apps, ensuring your entire health journey is in one place. It’s a perfect tool for anyone looking to stay on track.
